title: Prosecution: Still no explanation for VP’s P817.87M wealth

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — After nearly a month, Vice President Sara Duterte’s defense lawyers still have to present witnesses who can clearly account for her P817.87 million in unexplained wealth, for which she is on trial in the Senate impeachment court. The prosecution pointed this out in a press conference on Monday, through two House prosecution spokespersons — Rep. Zia Alonto Adiong and former Rep. Robert Ace Barbers. Barbers questioned wealth, bank balances missing from Duterte’s asset declarations, and her business interests while serving as vice president.
